summary.text: Kelly Quinn is the Republican candidate for Nevada State Assembly District 5 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Democrat Brittney Miller.
Quinn, a former Nevada Department of Corrections officer and REALTOR, ran for the same seat in 2022 and 2024.

paragraphs.text: Quinn was born in Newport, Oregon, and said in a 2026 Ballotpedia survey that he has lived in Nevada for 38 years and in Assembly District 5 for 28 years.

His career experience includes working as a corrections officer with the Nevada Department of Corrections, as a REALTOR, as a wildland firefighter, in safety and compliance in the hazardous materials industry, and with local fire department and ambulance services.
He has served with the Central Nevada EMS Council and the Nevada Emergency Medical Association and is a member of the Fraternal Order of Police, according to his survey.
Quinn was the candidate against Brittney Miller in the 2022 and 2024 general elections for Nevada State Assembly District 5, and he won the June 11, 2024 Republican primary over Alan Bigelow.
In his 2026 survey, he listed public safety, education, including school choice and parental rights, and diversifying Nevada's economy as his key messages.
